title: Progressive
description: Transcribed from src/match/rules/progressive.cpp. Legacy OnCardDrawn sets CardDrawnEvent::keep_drawing, which drives the draw loop (src/match/match_instance.cpp:699-723) to keep drawing until a playable card appears. Phase-1 equivalent: an after:draw hook branches on the  drawn_card_playable predicate; when the just-drawn card is already playable the loop stops, otherwise the  draw_until_playable op keeps drawing from the draw pile for @self until the freshly drawn card is playable (or the source is exhausted, reshuffling the discard when it can).
